audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phase reasons are shared template text and the packet flags that the page never names a single Heimerdinger ability.
audit.why: The lane is decided by the H-28 G Evolution Turret nest and the CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade's 11s stun, not by a generic 'chip war'.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten naming the turret, the rockets, the grenade and UPGRADE!!!.

audit.whatIsWrong: The item stages named no reason and level 6 said only 'his ultimate changes the math too'.
audit.why: UPGRADE!!! is 100s at rank 1 and empowers his next spell — the empowered grenade is a triple stun, which is what actually kills you at 6. Your spike is Lich Bane used to burst him off his nest.
audit.corrected: phases[4] names UPGRADE!!!, phases[5] and phases[6] key your all-in to killing him away from the turrets.

audit.whatIsWrong: The one interaction that wins this lane was never stated: turrets are units that must target you, and inside Twilight Shroud you cannot be selected, so the nest stops shooting.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud makes Akali 'invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' — a turret's basic attack needs a selectable target. His grenade is ground-placed and still lands.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[1].why, dosFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t, with the ground-placed grenade named as the exception.

audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade a flat 11s, Hextech Micro-Rockets 11s at rank 1 over 1325 range, UPGRADE!!! 100s at rank 1; your W is 20s and E 16s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[3], phases[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Poke-war into turrets' was described as diving with no shroud and no energy.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title.

edits.before: His turrets out-poke you — build MR, shroud his stun. Akali wins the CH-2 Grenade cooldown windows.
edits.after: His turrets out-poke you — build MR, shroud the nest. Akali wins the Electron Grenade windows.

edits.before: Build MR and shroud his stun. Track CH-2 Grenade before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Build MR and shroud his stun. The grenade is a flat 11s — kill him in the gap, off his turrets.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Heimerdinger contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His H-28 G Evolution Turret holds the wave and chips you for free. Farm at Q tip and never contest the nest early.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade is down.
edits.after: Turrets need a target, and inside Twilight Shroud you cannot be selected — the nest stops firing.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Heimerdinger must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online: his Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 to your 550 kunai, so you close with E or you do not close at all.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around CH-2 Grenade's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: his Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s and only stuns on a direct hit — bait it, then walk in.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Heimerdinger's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but UPGRADE!!! (100s) empowers his next spell — an upgraded grenade is far more stun than you can eat.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on CH-2 Grenade's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight away from the turret nest, on his grenade.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Heimerdinger carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and he dies in one rotation, but he re-holds the lane instantly — take the tower, not just the kill.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s): stuns only on a direct hit, and it is ground-placed, so smoke will not blank it. - His turrets need a target, and Shroud denies them one. - UPGRADE!!! (100s): the empowered grenade is the danger.

edits.before: Q Heimerdinger at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at 550, E-mark and dash past the turrets once the grenade is spent, then Shroud the nest.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Standing in the nest with Shroud down — the turrets chip while a direct grenade stuns you flat.

edits.before: Q Heimerdinger at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: His whole kit is magic damage, so magic resist reads on the turrets, the rockets and the grenade.

edits.before: Heimerdinger wastes CH-2 Grenade (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Smoke denies the turrets a target, though not the ground-placed grenade.

edits.before: That is Heimerdinger's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Three turrets plus a direct grenade stun is more damage than one rotation buys.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: It stuns only on a direct hit — sidestep and you take the splash slow.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Micro-Rockets reach 1325 against your 550 kunai, so trading at range is always a losing bet.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Shroud-dodge it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Turrets need a target and Shroud denies them one. The grenade is ground-placed and stuns on a direct hit.

notes: The packet's defect for this matchup was that the page never named any Heimerdinger ability; the full layer now names the turret, the rockets, the grenade and UPGRADE!!!. The Shroud-versus-turret point is derived from Riot's own wording for Twilight Shroud ('unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks') rather than from a documented interaction, so I marked it Medium and would want it confirmed in game before it is treated as certain.
